'''Korkie Kryze''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] student who attended at the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the nephew of [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].

==Biography==
[[File:SatineAquarium.png|thumb|left|240px|Korkie visits Satine in her apartment]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Korkie Kryze studied at the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]], along with [[Amis/Legends|Amis]], [[Soniee/Legends|Soniee]], and [[Lagos/Legends|Lagos]],<ref name="TA" /> where he was being groomed for leadership.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During the purported food shortage on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], along with his friends, Korkie broke into the food ration warehouse, only to discover that the food shortage was a lie, fabricated in order to strengthen the black market economy on Mandalore, which had become the only source of food during the false shortage. Recording the situation on a hologram, they took the evidence to the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], who informed them that she would handle the issue, and that the students should not get involved.<ref name="TA" />

Korkie suggested they bring the evidence to [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], since he considered Almec to be a more trustworthy individual. Almec arranged a meeting with the cadets to obtain the evidence of corruption, but it was a setup to arrest the students.<ref name="TA" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:OlderKorkieIsAngryKorkie-TL.png|thumb|right|200px|Korkie while defending his aunt, Satine]]</div>
However, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was able to rescue Korkie and his friends from captivity. Performing an analysis on the hologram, Tano revealed it was Almec who was behind the dealings. After attempting to take the new evidence to Satine, they soon discovered Satine had been captured by Almec. Tano formulated a plan to present the students as prisoners to Almec in order to find Satine's location, however Almec didn't fall for their ploy. After being recaptured, Korkie and his friends were forced to wait while Tano attempted to find Satine on her own. During her search, Tano was captured by Almec, and the students were brought in to be [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] in the hopes that Satine would sign a confession for committing [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Tano escaped from capture, and with the help of the students, she neutralized the guards and captured Almec, removing a source of corruption from the Mandalorian government.<ref name="TA" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] took over Mandalore under the leadership of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Korkie, along with Amis, Soniee, Lagos, and [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]] and the [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]], rescued the Duchess from the [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]]. They were pursued by [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]], but they were able to get Satine out of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] so that she was able to send a message for help to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Unfortunately, Satine was recaptured, but Korkie and the other students managed to escape the Mandalorian super commandos during the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|Battle of Sundari]], but not before being knocked to the ground from a punch by one of the commandos.<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Korkie is portrayed by voice actor [[Whit Hertford]].<ref name="TA" />
